# E0224: expansion too deep

A macro may use itself, but each expansion must get closer to an arm that stops, and expansions nest at most 128 deep.

- Rule: [`macros.nested-expansions`](../../reference/16-meta.md#macros.nested-expansions)
- Reported at: the use the user wrote.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0224:6
syntax sum {
  ($x: expr) => $x + sum!($x)
}

fn main() / io {
  print("{sum!(1)}")
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
syntax sum {
  ($x: expr) => $x
  ($x: expr, $($rest: expr),+) => $x + sum!($($rest),+)
}

fn main() / io {
  print("{sum!(1, 2, 3)}")
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0224_expansion_too_deep.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0224_expansion_too_deep.lt):

```text
── EXPANSION TOO DEEP ──────────────── E0224_expansion_too_deep.lt:6:11  [E0224]

Expansions of `sum!` nest more than 128 deep:

  6 │   print("{sum!(1)}")
    │           ^^^^^^^

A macro may use itself, but each expansion must get closer to an arm that stops,
and expansions nest at most 128 deep.
```
